Google Meet Attendance Tracker for Teachers in the Philippines

Taking manual roll call for 40 to 90 students in Google Meet eats up valuable lecture time. Here is how Filipino teachers, DepEd faculty, and university professors take automated attendance and export directly to Google Sheets — without an expensive Google Workspace for Education Plus upgrade.

Built for Philippine School Workspaces: Works with personal @gmail.com accounts, official DepEd accounts (@deped.gov.ph or regional divisions), and state/private university domains (@*.edu.ph including CEU, NEU, EVSU, UMak, BatStateU, UP, UST, DLSU, and more).
Why Google's Built-In Attendance Report Doesn't Show Up

In the Philippines, most public schools under the Department of Education (DepEd) and state universities operate on Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals (the free tier provided to educational institutions).

Google restricts its native attendance tracking reports exclusively to the high-tier Education Plus license. For teachers with Fundamentals accounts, Google Meet does not send any attendance email or spreadsheet after your call ends.

Attendance Tracker operates directly as a certified Google Workspace Marketplace side-panel add-on. Because it uses Google Meet's public add-on API, it functions on any Workspace edition — including free Fundamentals accounts and personal Gmail accounts.
Key Features for Online Classes & Synchronous Lectures
📋 Instant Auto Roll-Call
No need to shout names or ask students to type "Present" in the chat box. Every joining student is logged automatically in real time.
⏰ Late Arrival Flags
Students who join 5+ minutes after class starts automatically get flagged with a clear late chip (e.g. +12m late) next to their name.
⏱️ Total Duration & Disconnections
Tracks actual time spent in class. If student Wi-Fi cuts out and they reconnect, their total active minutes are merged into one clean record.
📊 1-Click Google Sheets Export
Exports clean spreadsheets directly into your Google Drive folder ("Meet Attendance Tracker"), formatted with student names, emails, and durations.
⚡ Hands-Free Auto-Export
Never forget to save attendance. Turn on auto-export in Settings, and the spreadsheet is saved and emailed to you the moment your class ends.
🎓 Class Attendance Certificates
Generate professional attendance verification certificates in PDF for webinars, seminars, workshops, and required training modules.
How to Use It for Your Next Class
Install the Add-on: Open the Attendance Tracker Google Marketplace page and click Install.
Open Google Meet: Start your scheduled class or meeting link.
Open the Side Panel: Click the Activities / Add-ons icon (next to the chat icon in Google Meet) and select Attendance Tracker.
Conduct Your Class: The roster updates automatically as students join, leave, or speak.
Save Your Sheet: Click Save to Sheets or enable auto-export so it automatically saves to your Google Drive when you hang up.
Frequently Asked Questions for Philippine Teachers
Does this work if students join using personal Gmail addresses?

Yes. Regardless of whether students join from their official school domain or their personal Gmail account, Attendance Tracker captures their Google display name and email address accurately in the attendance roster.
Can I track large lecture classes of 50 to 100+ students?
Yes. Attendance Tracker is engineered to handle large college lecture halls and webinar sessions with 100+ attendees smoothly with zero browser slowdown.
Is student data kept private and secure?

Yes. Attendance Tracker does not sell data, does not show third-party ads, and never reads the contents of your meeting, camera feed, or microphone. Spreadsheets are saved directly inside your personal Google Drive account.
Is there an educator discount for unlimited exports?

Yes! With regional pricing for the Philippines, teachers can get the Educator Pass for ₱199/year (Pro Annual ₱399/year) or a one-time Lifetime Pass for ₱399–₱799 with no recurring fees (GCash, Maya, and cards supported). Both options provide unlimited class exports, automated background capture, and student certificates.
